name: Pro Audit Log Explorer
description: SOC 2-ready audit log explorer: infinite, virtualised event table (TanStack Table + Virtual + Query) with faceted actor / action / resource filters, date-range picker, URL-synced state (nuqs), before/after JSON diff drawer (jsondiffpatch), CSV export and relative / absolute time toggle.

props.name: fetchPage
props.description: Cursor-paginated loader ({ filters, cursor, pageSize, signal }) returning events, nextCursor, total and facets

props.name: filters / defaultFilters / onFiltersChange
props.description: Controlled or uncontrolled filters (q, actors, actions, resources, from, to)

props.name: onExport
props.description: Replace built-in CSV export (e.g. server export job)

props.name: exportLimit
props.description: Cap for exporting all matching events

props.name: onEventOpen
props.description: Fires when an event opens in the drawer

props.name: renderEventActions
props.description: Extra actions in the drawer footer

props.name: queryKey / queryClient
props.description: Share an existing React Query cache

props.name: height / rowHeight
props.description: Viewport and row sizing for virtualisation

usage: Wrap in a nuqs adapter when using useAuditLogUrlState; otherwise pass filters / onFiltersChange yourself.
